The search turned up consistent core facts, though the sources are mostly vendor blogs and a few details conflict.

- **Count:** Sources agree that 20 states have a comprehensive consumer privacy law in effect as of January 2026, per the IAPP's tracker, which counts a law once its effective date has passed.
- **January 1, 2026:** Indiana, Kentucky, and Rhode Island were the newest additions, each taking effect on January 1, 2026.
- **Other 2026 dates:** One roundup lists July 1 for Connecticut, Arkansas, and Utah. Another notes that Connecticut is enhancing sensitive data definitions and youth protections effective July 1, 2026. Virginia's amendments banning the sale of precise geolocation data are effective July 1, 2026.
- **Later effective date:** Oklahoma's law does not take effect until January 1, 2027.
- **Pending:** One source says four additional states passed their own laws during 2026 that had not yet taken effect as of this post's July 2026 refresh. Another reports that Governor Phil Scott signed the Vermont Data Privacy and Online Surveillance Act (VDPOSA) into law on June 16, 2026. I could not confirm the other pending states from these results.

**Caveats:** The sources conflict on the total and on some dates. Several are vendor blogs, and one 2026 dataset reports 20 U.S. states have comprehensive data privacy laws, which matches the count above. Verify individual effective dates against the statutes or the IAPP tracker before relying on them for compliance.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

content.text:
Twenty states had a comprehensive consumer privacy law in effect as of January 2026. The search results didn't list each law's name, so the names and most dates below come from my own knowledge. The 2026 and later items and the count come from the search.

| State | Law | Effective |
|---|---|---|
| California | California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), amended by the CPRA | Jan 1, 2020 (CPRA amendments Jan 1, 2023) |
| Virginia | Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA) | Jan 1, 2023 |
| Colorado | Colorado Privacy Act | Jul 1, 2023 |
| Connecticut | Connecticut Data Privacy Act (CTDPA) | Jul 1, 2023 |
| Utah | Utah Consumer Privacy Act | Dec 31, 2023 |
| Texas | Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (TDPSA) | Jul 1, 2024 |
| Oregon | Oregon Consumer Privacy Act | Jul 1, 2024 (nonprofits Jul 1, 2025) |
| Florida | Florida Digital Bill of Rights (applies only to very large companies) | Jul 1, 2024 |
| Montana | Montana Consumer Data Privacy Act | Oct 1, 2024 |
| Delaware | Delaware Personal Data Privacy Act | Jan 1, 2025 |
| Iowa | Iowa Consumer Data Protection Act | Jan 1, 2025 |
| Nebraska | Nebraska Data Privacy Act | Jan 1, 2025 |
| New Hampshire | New Hampshire Privacy Act | Jan 1, 2025 |
| New Jersey | New Jersey Data Privacy Act | Jan 15, 2025 |
| Tennessee | Tennessee Information Protection Act | Jul 1, 2025 |
| Minnesota | Minnesota Consumer Data Privacy Act | Jul 31, 2025 |
| Maryland | Maryland Online Data Privacy Act (MODPA) | Oct 1, 2025 |
| Indiana | Indiana Consumer Data Protection Act | Jan 1, 2026 |
| Kentucky | Kentucky Consumer Data Protection Act | Jan 1, 2026 |
| Rhode Island | Rhode Island Data Transparency and Privacy Protection Act | Jan 1, 2026 |

**Not yet in effect:**
- **Oklahoma:** its law takes effect Jan 1, 2027, per the search. I didn't get its name.
- **Vermont:** one source reports the governor signed the Vermont Data Privacy and Online Surveillance Act on June 16, 2026. I couldn't confirm its effective date.
- **Other states:** one source says four more states passed laws during 2026, but I couldn't identify them.

**Amendments:** Connecticut's updates to sensitive-data and youth protections and Virginia's ban on selling precise geolocation data both take effect Jul 1, 2026.

The sources were mostly vendor blogs and they disagreed on some details. For compliance purposes, check the statutes or the IAPP state-law tracker, especially for the newest laws.

Sources:
- [20 State Privacy Laws in Effect in 2026](https://www.multistate.us/insider/2026/2/4/all-of-the-comprehensive-privacy-laws-that-take-effect-in-2026)
- [U.S. State Privacy Laws: The 2026 Comparison Guide](https://www.clym.io/blog/us-privacy-law-comparison-map)
- [Morgan Lewis: US State Consumer Privacy Law Update](https://www.morganlewis.com/pubs/2026/07/us-state-consumer-privacy-law-update-notable-changes-across-existing-frameworks)
- [State Privacy in Brief, Q1 2026](https://www.bakerdatacounsel.com/blogs/state-privacy-in-brief-q1-2026/)
- [20 US State Privacy Laws in 2026](https://privacyterms.io/us-state-privacy-laws-2026)
